latest.notes: Time-authoritative recovery: the on-air log now dictates what plays based on the clock. After ANY disruption — a stall, a network blip, the machine left off or asleep — the player jumps to the element the schedule says is due right now and purges the backed-up stale rows (old music AND empty commercial breaks), instead of grinding forward through hours of backlog. New safeguards run continuously: an idle auto-mode station puts itself back on air, a drift watchdog resyncs when playback falls >10 min behind schedule, and a deliberate operator Stop is respected. No 12am ceremony — the log is one continuous, always-look-ahead timeline.
